items.title: Yuvaan
items.subtitle: Mars rover programme
items.summary: Ever wondered what goes inside the core of a hyped space expedition programme? Yuvaan is the club's Mars-rover team.
items.overview: Yuvaan explores what it takes to land on another planet and operate there — through the design and development of a planetary rover. The team works across chassis and suspension, power, communication, manipulation and autonomy.

items.title: Artificial-reality Glasses
items.summary: A pair of glasses that does more than just correct your vision.

items.title: Drivezee
items.summary: A small-scale bot driven by an IC engine.
items.overview: Drivezee is built in two phases. Phase one focuses on the design of an RC-operated, engine-powered car. Phase two addresses the transmission and transfer of power to the wheels.

items.title: Exoskeleton
items.summary: A shoulder-assistive wearable exoskeleton.
items.overview: An exoskeleton is a wearable electromechanical structure intended to resemble, and allow movement similar to, the human skeletal system. This project builds a shoulder-assistive exoskeleton.

items.title: FiDo
items.summary: An all-terrain, joystick-controlled bot that can roll on any surface.
items.overview: Thanks to its wheel-like shape, FiDo can roll over any surface and go anywhere within its wireless range, controlled by a joystick. Applications include security and surveillance.

items.title: Marjanator
items.summary: An autonomous vessel that collects floating waste from water bodies.

items.title: Pipe Traversing Bot
items.summary: A bot for gas-pipeline inspection and maintenance.
items.overview: The bot travels through pipelines to identify and report damage without manual intervention.

items.title: Robotic Arm
items.summary: A 6-DOF robotic arm that can fold into a small space.
items.overview: A robotic arm with six degrees of freedom and the ability to fold into a compact space, targeting industrial automation and medical applications.

items.title: Talking Bot
items.summary: A voice-recognition chatbot built with sequence models and NLP, inspired by Alexa and Siri.

items.title: Wall Plotter
items.summary: Give it an image and it controls a pen to draw it on a wall, automatically.

items.title: RuTag's Agrobot
items.summary: The agricultural robot that won first place at Inter IIT Tech Meet 9.0.
items.overview: The Agrobot uses a rocker-bogie mechanism to navigate farm terrain. A vacuum pump picks up seeds, a tree-spade system handles transplanting, and a camera identifies weeds.

items.title: DIC's Terrace Farming Robot
items.summary: A lightweight autonomous farming bot that climbs terrace steps. Second place at Inter IIT Tech Meet 8.0.
items.overview: The robot climbs steep terrace steps and navigates reliably across uneven terrain to plough, seed, water and harvest.

items.title: Technology for Soldier Support
items.summary: A wearable suit with sensors for motion detection and real-time tracking.
items.overview: After a training period, the suit detects the wearer's motion and transmits real-time tracking information to a base station.

items.title: Safety Devices for Fishing Vessels
items.summary: Ship-proximity alerts for fishing vessels using AIS signals and solar-powered buoys.
items.overview: Ship distance is estimated from AIS signal power, a directional antenna estimates the direction of approach, and alerts are relayed over RF through a network of solar-powered buoys.

items.title: Biped
items.summary: A 10-DOF two-legged robot that walks on flat surfaces.

items.title: Planar Manipulator
items.summary: A planar arm modelled on the human hand, capable of pattern-based writing, path traversal and object manipulation.

items.title: Replication Bot
items.summary: A microcontroller-based arm that mirrors the motion of a synchronised replica.

items.title: Robotic Drawing Machine
items.summary: A two-axis pen-drawing machine for those short on drawing skill or time.

items.title: Shape Shifter
items.summary: A terrain-adaptive wheel inspired by DARPA's shape-shifting wheel for all-terrain vehicles.

items.title: Wall Follower
items.summary: An Arduino robot that follows a wall while holding a fixed distance from it.

items.title: Warehouse Management
items.summary: A fully autonomous bot that avoids obstacles to locate, lift and transport inventory.

items.title: Augmata
items.summary: Augmented reality that enhances the real world with sounds, images and interactive virtual objects.

items.title: Ballet of Bots
items.summary: PID control of a weighted ball on a flat surface, moving it precisely to set-points.

items.title: Cyrus
items.summary: A vehicle that tracks a sound source and drives autonomously towards it, using low-cost sensors and voice recognition.

items.title: Lazy Fill
items.summary: Automated water-bottle filling that removes the manual steps.

items.title: Rearranging Robotic Arm
items.summary: A 4R arm with vision and control for sorting, rearranging, obstacle avoidance and trajectory planning.

items.title: Rubik's Cube Solver
items.summary: Scans a cube and solves it with stepper motors on an acrylic, pillar-mounted frame.

items.title: Stair Climbing Robot
items.summary: A six-wheeled NodeMCU bot with a self-adjusting gimbal plate that climbs stairs.
items.overview: The robot uses high-torque DC motors, a self-adjusting gimbal plate, a flexible front elbow joint and rigid rear arms to climb stairs, all controlled through a NodeMCU.

items.title: All Terrain Vehicle
items.summary: A rocker-bogie vehicle, the Mars-rover mechanism for crossing rough terrain while staying stable.

items.title: Attendance Taking Bot
items.summary: Automated attendance recording using face recognition.

items.title: Cycle Lock
items.summary: A Bluetooth lock that turns the key with a servo, driven by an Arduino Micro.

items.title: Automated Ball Collector
items.summary: The true tennis buddy: place it on the court and it collects the balls for you.

items.title: Bi-pedal Robot
items.summary: A ROS-controlled biped robot driven by a joystick.

items.title: The Robotic Arm
items.summary: An arm that finds coloured balls in 3D space and grasps them automatically.

items.title: Deltabot
items.summary: A parallel delta robot whose parallelogram arms keep the end-effector's orientation fixed.
items.overview: A delta robot has three arms connected to universal joints at the base. Its parallelogram arms keep the end-effector's orientation constant, the design used in industrial picking and packaging at up to 300 picks per minute.

items.title: Hive v2.0
items.summary: The club's first prototype of an autonomous, intelligent multi-robot swarm system, built to be expanded.

items.title: Mobile Printer
items.summary: A mobile robot that writes letters and words by driving around.

items.title: Rubik's Cube Solver (v1)
items.summary: Image processing detects the scrambled state, computes a solution and drives grippers to execute it.

items.title: Transformer
items.summary: A modular robot in the spirit of the Transformers films, part of an evolving robot ecosystem.

items.title: Vein Finder
items.summary: Near-infrared LEDs and a filtered camera make veins visible beneath the skin.
items.overview: A U-shaped arrangement of LEDs projects near-infrared light. Blood absorbs it while tissue reflects it, so veins stand out when viewed through an infrared-filtered camera.
